name: What maintenance is required for a heated towel rack?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for a heated towel rack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Heated towel racks typically require minimal maintenance, primarily involving routine cleaning to maintain their appearance. For stainless steel or chrome finishes, a soft cloth and mild cleaner are usually sufficient. It is important to avoid abrasive cleaners that could damage the finish. Beyond cleaning, periodic checks for any visible wear on cords or connections, particularly for plug-in models, can ensure continued safe operation. AKN Design Group selects quality fixtures and ensures proper installation, contributing to the longevity and reliability of your luxury bathroom features.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance primarily involves routine cleaning with a soft cloth and mild cleaner; avoid abrasives. Periodically check cords/connections for plug-in models to ensure safe operation.
